ASSET: Sweet Home 3D / Scopia "Coconut tree" (coconutTree, straight, 11.0 m) and "Coconut tree bended" (coconutTreeBended, curved, 10.0 m)
CATEGORY: vegetation -> SM_PalmTree_A (coconutTreeBended, curved ~10-11 m) and SM_PalmTree_B (coconutTree, straighter; scale to ~8 m)
          Most realistic palm found: fully modelled fronds with individual leaflets (no alpha cards), coconuts, 512px texture atlas.
DOWNLOADED FROM (2026-10-28, all HTTP 200, non-HTML):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arxistence/sweethome3d-git-mirror/master/3DModels/scopia/scopia/coconutTree/coconutTree.obj  (+ coconutTree.mtl, coconutTreeTexture.jpg)
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arxistence/sweethome3d-git-mirror/master/3DModels/scopia/scopia/coconutTreeBended/coconutTreeBended.obj  (+ coconutTreeBended.mtl, coconutTreeTexture.jpg - byte-identical to the one above)

FILES:
  original/   unmodified OBJ/MTL/JPG as downloaded (units cm, Y-up; 81,006 tris each; 3 materials Coconut/Leaves/Trunk
              all mapped onto coconutTreeTexture.jpg 512x512; leaves are cut geometry -> opaque, no alpha needed).
  game_ready/ coconutTree_20k.gltf, coconutTreeBended_20k.gltf: our derivative (Blender 5.2): meshes joined, Decimate
              (collapse) 81k -> 20,000 tris (visually identical at game distances, see previews/), scaled to metres,
              origin at trunk base centre, glTF 2.0 Y-up, double-sided materials.
              Sizes: coconutTree 7.8 x 8.0 x 11.0 m; coconutTreeBended 7.3 x 7.5 x 10.0 m.
  previews/   Cycles renders of the game-ready files.
TECH NOTES: Blender 5.2 import OK (OBJ + glTF), no missing images. Texture is low-res (512) - consider a UE material
  with detail normal / colour tweak (trunk reads very pale grey; tint warmer brown in the material).
DATE: 2026-10-28
